messages.text: BL-1788 🎵 in progress — BL-363's in-process CLI guard is red on main in two of its five scenarios (coder note 002194, 2026-09-27), each red for weeks because nothing runs the whole acceptance suite: scenario 02 finds two node spawns in fleetConsoleCli.test.js (BL-437 added an env-default CLI spawn, 2026-07-15) and in telegramFrontDeskBotCli.test.js (BL-1620 added a node probe subprocess, 2026-09-18); scenario 04's handler looks for a git init in negotiateOnboardingContractCli's beforeAll, and BL-1039 (2026-08-22) replaced that with the shared seeded-repo copy. The two extra spawns move in-process and scenario 04's proof accepts the seeded-fixture build, with no check loosened
